scope: The former Walker Theatre at 364 Smith Street in Winnipeg as the Burton Cummings Theatre in July 2014. It includes the three-storey ornamental limestone entrance, marquee, attached unadorned brick auditorium and fly tower.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The City of Winnipeg designation records the three-storey stone entrance, the four-storey brick auditorium, the keystone arch, blind windows, modillioned cornice and 21.4 m fly tower.
The federal record confirms the right-angled, stepped masses, arched window, cornices and metal marquee.
